name: Agent sandbox
description: Runs the dev container as a sandbox for coding agents: only under gVisor, all traffic through the sandbox's own credential proxy and egress filter, workspace in a Docker volume. Needs the agent-sandbox start step in initializeCommand.

project.description: Project name: chooses the folder ~/.agent-sandbox/<project>/ with your secrets, credential rules and rule files for this project. Empty means the folder name. Read by the start step, not by this feature.
